task_and_failure: Native Claude interruption and same-session continuation were not established by onboarding, process liveness or a completed native child task.
discovery_provenance: Named Claude-native recovery gap after the separate Mac Codex tool-turn qualification.
license_and_compatibility: Original MIT synthetic fixture; Python standard-library supervision on Linux/WSL2 with existing native Claude2.1.278, native authentication and per-invocation Opus5/Ultracode.

baseline_and_candidate.baseline: No same-session native recovery qualification; no model baseline run
baseline_and_candidate.candidate: One durable checkpoint; interrupt owned pending Bash operation; resume exact native session and finalize without replay

predeclared_metrics.quality_rule: Observe pending native Bash and owned process; SIGINT stops first CLI; same native session resumes; exact checkpoint/wait/finalize action journal and unchanged checkpoint/frozen bytes; final native result and owned cleanup pass.
predeclared_metrics.usage_rule: Retain both terminal usage views and reconcile against resumed cumulative model counts without double counting; retries/billing/coordinator and provider cancellation remain unknown.

runtime_and_platform.isolation: Owned synthetic Git fixture; separate native process groups, Bash only with precise allowed commands; no child agents or global/account/service writes.

observations.scope: One frozen native Claude Opus5 Bash checkpoint, SIGINT to owned CLI, and same-session resume on one Linux WSL2 host

limitations: One synthetic same-host CLI session recovery attempt; no independent-host, network, power-loss or whole-ecosystem guarantee.
SIGINT and process observations do not confirm remote provider cancellation or billing cessation.
The same native session ID is verified privately; no raw transcript replay or --fork-session is used.
Explicit Opus5 and Ultracode are scoped to this trial; this does not qualify the best alias or another model. No child agent is allowed.
Cumulative resumed results and per-model counters can have different scopes; interrupted usage can be incomplete. Retain categories separately and do not add them.
Full streams, process identities and session identifiers remain private. Cleanup targets owned CLI process groups and the identity-verified owned wait, not shared services.
Observed SIGINT timing and live-process state are supervisor evidence; the independent retained-stream audit verifies session identity, exact native actions, final bytes and accounting.
Both original terminal results are retained. The original recorder left a combined total unknown; the independent audit subsequently reconciles disjoint categories against cumulative model counts.

The current supervisor now protects the containing source repository and retains cleanup errors after review; the native trial used the separately preserved executed runner, and no model rerun followed these hardening changes.

decision_and_scope.scope: One frozen native Claude Opus5 Bash checkpoint, SIGINT to owned CLI, and same-session resume on one Linux WSL2 host

rollback: Stop only owned CLI process groups and identity-verified owned wait; retain existing native session history and private fixture evidence.
next_decision_changing_test: Independent-host restoration or a real application operation with a frozen external-effect reconciliation rule.
